claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars take place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 Oscars start at 7:00 p.m. ET / 4:00 p.m. PT.
Conan O'Brien hosts the 2026 Oscars ceremony.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony is at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
Official red carpet coverage for the 2026 Oscars begins at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.
The 2026 Oscars air on TV channel ABC.
The 2026 Oscars are available to stream on Hulu, YouTubeTV, FuboTV, and ABC.com.
